# Email Server Template

This template provides a complete email server solution using Docker Mailserver with Roundcube webmail interface.

## Features
- Full SMTP/IMAP email server
- Anti-spam (Rspamd)
- Anti-virus (ClamAV)
- Fail2Ban protection
- Webmail interface (Roundcube)
- SSL/TLS support with Let's Encrypt

## Setup
1. Set your domain in the DOMAIN environment variable
2. Configure DNS records (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
3. Access webmail at your configured domain
4. Create email accounts using the setup script

## Post-deployment
Run the following commands to create email accounts:

# Access the mailserver container
docker exec -it <container_name> setup email add user@domain.com [password]
